Product Details: Bright & Energy-Saving: Experience 1000 lumens of powerful cool white (6500K) brightness which makes it best solar flood light for garden, parking & security areas. Runs entirely on solar energy, giving you ₹0 power cost and saving ₹115 every month*. High-Capacity Battery: Features a 5000mAh LiFePO₄ rechargeable battery delivering up to 14 hours of continuous lighting, ensuring reliable illumination from dusk to dawn even in low-sunlight conditions. Fast & Efficient Solar Charging: Equipped with a 6W monocrystalline solar panel, the light charges fully in 4–6 hours of direct sunlight – designed to deliver optimal performance in Indian sunlight conditions. All-Weather Performance: Built tough with an IP65-rated waterproof and dustproof design, UV-resistant ABS body and tempered glass front, ensuring long-lasting durability in rain, dust, and heat. Smart Remote Control: Control your light with ON/OFF, Bright/Dim, 2H/4H/6H timers, and Auto Dusk-to-Dawn mode for effortless and intelligent outdoor lighting management. Easy DIY Installation: No Wiring, No Hassle – mount anywhere using the 2-meter cable provided. Ideal for quick setup in terrace, parking, driveways, courtyards, garden boundaries, or gate areas. Designed for Indian Homes: Engineered for Indian weather and usage conditions, featuring BIS-approved battery, 12 months warranty, and Dylect’s reliable after-sales support for complete peace of mind.
